name: system_get_state

provenance.source: exact 4.100.155 IDB vela_ap.bin.i64 (PowerManager, MiWearScreen, miwear_vibrator library and property library review)

notes: system_all_state getter (get_connect_state/get_switch_state/...): zeroes out[0..1] then stores the state byte. id 1 is the MiWear connection (0 not reported, 1 down, 2 up). Spins forever (Band 10 Pro) or panics (Band 11) when system_init_state has not run, so the state pointer must be checked first. Supervisor platform hardware service; static evidence only, device NOT_PROBED.
